# Quick start — View this repository

Welcome! A few short steps to see the Learning Hub files and start contributing.

- To view the learning files, switch the branch selector (top-left) to Dev.
- The main learning plan is LEARNING_PLAN.md in the repository root and weekly notes are in docs/ (for example docs/week-01.md and docs/week-02.md).
- To request a metadata update, click Issues → New issue, then choose the "Update metadata" template.
- To make small changes: create a short-lived branch, edit the file, open a Pull Request into Dev, and merge after review.

If you need help at any step, tell me and I will walk you through the exact clicks.
